notes: Targets are locally served OpenAI-compatible vLLM endpoints from the model-deploy stack folder outside this repo: GLM-5.3-Flash on GPUs 0-3 (host port 7999) and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP8 on GPUs 6-7 (host port 8002).
The judge is a fixed third model served single-GPU on the GPU free of both targets; its compose file lives in the model-deploy stack folder outside this repo. Start it before running.
apiKeyEnv names the environment variable holding each endpoint key. Key values are resolved from the environment at run time and are never written to committed files, logs, or comparison reports.
